# dfrenLearn

> dfrenLearn (Dfren Learn) teaches GEO, or generative engine optimization: how to make a website easy for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude to find, understand and recommend. It sells one course, The GEO Blueprint (1.5 hours, 6 modules, 499 INR one time, taught mostly in Tamil with English terms mixed in), and publishes sourced guides. Run by DFREN Marketing Agency, Tambaram, Chennai, India. Course and tools by AiVirex Innovations.

## Main pages

- [The GEO Blueprint course](https://learn.dfren.in/): curriculum, price, FAQ
- [About dfrenLearn](https://learn.dfren.in/about): who runs it and what the course includes
- [Contact](https://learn.dfren.in/contact): email, address, Grievance Officer
- [Guides on learning GEO in India](https://learn.dfren.in/blog): all articles
